zh-CN.name: 凯旋圣歌
zh-CN.realgame_details: 进入输出前配合完美逆行{perk|金中藏弹}空洞拒绝捡子弹常与众神辉煌配合使用\\{art-perk|动能合成}武器输出时用于拾取弹药盒填装，比如{perk|级联点}{perk|全明星}威胁等级

description.en: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
description.zh-CN: 滑行会收集附近的弹药，并在短时间内为你的武器提供强化的填装速度和操控性。

description.en: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
description.zh-CN: 用武器造成伤害会在短时间内提供强化滑行。滑行时会获得伤害抗性。

description.en: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.
description.zh-CN: 范围效果伤害、烈日技能、第七炽天使武器或似像者武器最后一击提供战争思维充能。每层战争思维充能都会提升你的武器和手雷属性。

description.en:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
description.zh-CN:
持有战争思维充能时，击败强力战斗人员、摧毁构造体，或摧毁缠结会释放一次烈日爆炸，对战斗人员造成伤害并治疗盟友。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

description.en: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
description.zh-CN: 你对战斗人员护盾、覆盖护盾、载具和构造体造成的动能伤害显著提升。构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

description.en: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
description.zh-CN: 使用动能伤害击败强力战斗人员或破坏战斗人员护盾会释放具有迷失效果的动能冲击波。

zh-CN.name: 欧里克斯记忆
zh-CN.realgame_details: 击杀{bar-orange|橙血}额外弹药进度

description.en: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
description.zh-CN: 对守护者和强力战斗人员造成最后一击时生成额外的弹药进度。

description.en: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，你获得隐形。

description.en: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
description.zh-CN: 随着你的生命值降低，你的武器获得稳定性和操控性提升。护盾耗尽时造成武器最后一击可获得治疗。

description.en: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
description.zh-CN: 当你的护盾破裂时，你在短时间内获得弹药生成速度、抖动抗性和对附近战斗人员伤害抗性提升。最后一击会延长此效果。

description.en: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
description.zh-CN: 受到强力战斗人员的近战伤害后立即开始回复生命值。

description.en: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器或偃月造成近战命中获得虹吸之触层数。切换武器会消耗所有层数来治疗你自己。

description.en: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.
description.zh-CN: 短时间内受到大量伤害会生成一层庇护之愿，让战斗人员更难命中你，并提供填装速度和抖动抗性加成。

description.en:
When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.
description.zh-CN:
庇护之愿失效时获得治愈。

快速最后一击会提前结束庇护之愿。

zh-CN.name: 光耀万钧
zh-CN.realgame_details: 电术双炮台、地磁靴搭配{el-arc|电荷思维}双倍{el-arc|离子轨迹}大招回转

description.en: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
description.zh-CN: 当处于增幅状态时，你的融合步枪、线性融合步枪以及热量武器可获得更高的操控性、填装和排气速度。

description.en: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
description.zh-CN: 以震颤造成最后一击，或对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击时，会生成离子轨迹。

description.en:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
description.zh-CN:
靠近盟友会生成一个中继网络，提升装备者的操控性和填装速度。

靠近其他友方网络管理员额外提升装备者的生命值属性。

description.en: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
description.zh-CN: 武器最后一击为装备者和附近盟友提供近战能量。

description.en: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
description.zh-CN: 手雷最后一击会在短时间内减少你受到的伤害。

description.en: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
description.zh-CN: 手雷最后一击会提供额外的重型弹药进度。

zh-CN.name: 埃希恩记忆
zh-CN.realgame_details: 最好最泛用的套装，可以优化掉一切配装中与产球有关的模组换成洗礼；{el-prismatic|棱镜}持续触发{el-prismatic|使命琢面}软硬减、{el-void|虚空}持续触发{el-void|饥饿回声}触发吞噬回血；同时他也是最好用的输出套装，持续补充{armor-charge|护甲充能}、给予生存能力、质变金枪狙/{art-perk|银白重炮}神器等等

zh-CN.应用场景: {orb|能量球}\\（输出\\{el-prismatic|棱镜}{el-void|虚空}软硬减）

description.en: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
description.zh-CN: 拾取能量球后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，在短时间内获得生命值属性加成并向周围释放一股活性放射体液。

description.en: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 拥有分支职业增益时，造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

description.en: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
description.zh-CN: 当一名盟友被击败时，提高主弹药武器的操控性、填装速度、目标捕获能力并减轻抖动。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成提升。

description.en: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
description.zh-CN: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击将使你暂时从雷达中消失。举起非主弹药武器将立即中断此效果。

zh-CN.name: 传承之誓
zh-CN.realgame_details: 10m {deb-arc|致盲}范围足够，最合适的是火小锤泰坦和升龙电猎，能够大大减少空近战的情况。飞蛾和好耶大范围近战通常会将周围怪一起击杀

description.en: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
description.zh-CN: 使用充能近战击败目标时额外释放一道迷失脉冲。

description.en: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
description.zh-CN: 你的护盾被战斗人员击破，或你使用超能时，发射大量追踪热源的微型导弹。

zh-CN.name: 艾昂适配
zh-CN.realgame_details: 爆炸武器击杀获取长达 15 秒的 20% 范围减伤\\注：范围伤害在所有伤害来源中大约占据 50% 的比例，等效 10% 减伤

description.en: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
description.zh-CN: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，暂时减少受到的范围效果伤害。

description.en: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
description.zh-CN: 力量吸收生效时，受到近战伤害将触发一次迷失爆发。

description.en: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药盒会提供可叠加的武器切换和收起速度加成，直到你死亡。

description.en: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
description.zh-CN: 对目标施加的悬停、瓦解和割裂效果，以及对自身施加的焕光和恢复效果拥有更长的持续时间。

description.en: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
description.zh-CN: 用刚刚拔出或填装的武器造成最后一击会治疗你。

description.en: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
description.zh-CN: 弓箭、霰弹枪或刀剑最后一击会暂时减少受到的伤害。使用这些武器对目标造成伤害可延长效果。

description.en: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
description.zh-CN: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，冲刺一小段时间来获得速度加成。

description.en: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
description.zh-CN: 每次激活力量转化器可生效一次，生命危急、被悬停或受冰影效果减速时冲刺，会立即获得短暂的速度加成。

description.en: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
description.zh-CN: 使用终结技时获得一个强大的覆盖护盾。终结目标时，在你周围释放一次减速爆发。

description.en: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
description.zh-CN: 造成伤害或最后一击时获得递增的伤害抗性。终结技提供更快的进度。层数叠满时，你的技能充能速度也将获得提升。

description.en: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
description.zh-CN: 施展终结技会存储能量。下一次你的护盾被击破时，消耗储备的能量立即获得治疗并开启生命值回复。

description.en: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
description.zh-CN: 拥有焕光、恢复或治愈时，你的近战命中会释放灼烧目标的冲击波。

zh-CN.name: 终曲
zh-CN.realgame_details: 低压环境击杀提供可观近战和手雷回转，对技能相关配装很有用（逃逸手、好耶泰坦等），抵抗 3 是锦上添花。摧毁构造体可触发，但仅有{exotic|死亡信使}霜袍术适合，冰猎和冰泰坦贪婪套更优

description.en: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
description.zh-CN: 光能武器最后一击提供赋予手雷属性的光能极性层数。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供赋予近战属性的暗影极性层数。

description.en: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
description.zh-CN: 光能武器最后一击提供额外手雷能量。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供额外近战能量。光能与暗影交替的快速最后一击在短时间内提供伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 渴望回响
zh-CN.realgame_details: 对元素拾取物多的电冰职业多给予的技能能量非常慷慨（几乎都是翻倍能量），有质变的效果。2 件套减伤

description.en: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药、能量球、元素拾取物，或摧毁缚丝缠结时获得无尽贪婪层数，略微降低所受伤害，并为已装备武器提供填装速度加成。当你的护盾被击破时，会失去部分层数。

description.en: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
description.zh-CN: 拥有无尽贪婪层数时，能量球和元素拾取物会提供更多对应能量，并且提升缚丝缠结造成的伤害。当你的护盾被击破时，所有层数会转化为一股能量球的泉涌。

zh-CN.name: 定制特机
zh-CN.realgame_details: 唯一的额外增伤效果套装，很适合剑狙翻新双切，好建议三切等等

description.en: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
description.zh-CN: 在击败一名强力战斗人员或守护者后收起武器，会为自身恢复少量生命值，并使附近战斗人员迷失方向。

description.en: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
description.zh-CN: 新拔出的武器在短时间内对战斗人员造成的精准伤害获得提升。装备特克斯平衡枪托原始特性的武器或由特克斯机械铸造厂制造的异域装备将获得进一步的提升。

zh-CN.name: 深渊探索者
zh-CN.realgame_details: 适合只有硬减没有软减的分支职业，输出场景也可以使用

description.en: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
description.zh-CN: 受到伤害会提升你已装备武器的填装速度，直到收起该武器。受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

description.en: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
description.zh-CN: 当你收起武器时，根据失去的苦涩锻造层数恢复生命值。

description.en: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
description.zh-CN: 终结战斗人员或复活盟友会开始光明邪魔族仪式。仪式生效期间，提升超能属性。

description.en: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
description.zh-CN: 收集能量球会延长典礼持续时间。典礼生效时，技能最后一击有几率生成友方电弧飞蛾。

description.en: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
description.zh-CN: 超凡未生效时，以独特元素伤害击败目标会提供可叠加的超凡能量获取加成。

description.en: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
description.zh-CN: 超凡生效时，使用手雷技能会消耗所有“叠加起来”层数来获得递增的手雷能量。

zh-CN.name: 黑暗纪元
zh-CN.realgame_details: 职业技能会释放一个小型治疗无人机，适合{el-strand|缚丝}猎松身裤这种缺少软减的分支。{el-prismatic|棱镜}{el-void|虚空}适合 vog4，火猎适合减伤套装。然而在多人环境下为所有人提供治疗效果非常不错，可根据自身需求选择，谁更优秀并不是绝对的。部分人可能会出现无法释放治疗无人机的 bug，切换套装或者让主动出击 buff 自然流失完可以解决

description.en: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
description.zh-CN: 使用近战攻击或刀剑打击命中战斗人员可获得主动出击层数，从而提升操控性和填装。层数会随时间缓慢衰减。

description.en: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
description.zh-CN: 拥有主动出击层数时，使用职业技能会生成一个位置固定的治疗光环。该光环的治疗量基于主动出击层数而提升。

zh-CN.name: 机械营套装
zh-CN.realgame_details: 加拉诺冰镐/{el-void|虚空}箭、{exotic|阿罕卡拉之颅}涡流大招、{exotic|圣火护心甲}无法正常生效\\持续型大招可以通过切换套装来刷新触发效果

description.en: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
description.zh-CN: 提升主弹药武器的操控性和填装速度。根据你的武器属性，提升主弹药武器对非首领战斗人员造成的伤害。

description.en: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
description.zh-CN: 超能生效期间造成的最后一击将在超能结束后返还超能能量。

description.en: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
description.zh-CN: 短暂冲刺会在一段时间内提升填装速度和操控性。最后一击可延长持续时间。

description.en: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
description.zh-CN: 肾上腺素亢奋生效期间，最后一击提供特殊弹药进度。对强力战斗人员、守护者及傀儡军团造成的最后一击可提供额外进度。

description.en: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.
description.zh-CN: 快速移动积累充能，逐渐提升你的生命值回复速度。全速轰鸣时，冲刺会提供速度加成。

description.en: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.
description.zh-CN: 速度加成生效时，滑行将震颤你前方的战斗人员。

description.en: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.
description.zh-CN: 滑行后主弹药武器会获得抖动抗性加成。

description.en: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.
description.zh-CN: 当盟友被击败或你复活盟友时，你的武器会获得暂时的操控性和瞄准速度提升。

description.en: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
description.zh-CN: 使用手雷造成最后一击会为热量武器提供稳定性和排气速度加成，并为主弹药武器提供稳定性和填装速度加成。

description.en: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
description.zh-CN: 使用热量武器或主弹药武器造成多次最后一击，会为武器和手雷属性提供加成，并提升热量武器和主弹药武器的弹药生成。

zh-CN.name: 梦境祸根
zh-CN.realgame_details: 获得的梦魇精华 buff 套用的就是原本的梦魇精华代码，可以获得对梦魇{enemy|战斗人员}大幅额外增伤，而二象性地牢的{bar-yellow|首领}全都是梦魇

description.en: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员或高阶目标造成最后一击可获得不稳定精华。拥有不稳定精华时，你会获得手雷和近战属性加成。

description.en: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
description.zh-CN: 拥有不稳定精华时，你的快速武器伤害或最后一击会提供治疗并开启生命值回复。

description.en: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
description.zh-CN: 你装备的武器弹匣剩余一半子弹时填装速度提升。

description.en: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
description.zh-CN: 填装武器可在短时间内提升其操控性及减少受到的抖动。如果武器拥有SUROS协同原始特性，则改为提升射程。

zh-CN.name: 众神辉煌
zh-CN.realgame_details: 捡起子弹获取{armor-charge|护甲充能}，常与凯旋圣歌配合使用\\也有搭配{art-perk|治疗能量球}/{art-perk|碎裂能量球}神器+层层不绝无限踢绿弹的玩法，实际使用不多

description.en: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药提供护甲充能。每层护甲充能都会提供生命值属性加成。

description.en: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
description.zh-CN: 对初级首领、勇士和首领造成持续伤害会提升对基础和强力战斗人员造成的武器伤害。每次造成武器最后一击时消耗一层。

zh-CN.name: 剑圣
zh-CN.realgame_details: 适合偃月玩法的高额抵抗 4 减伤

description.en:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
description.zh-CN:
使用刀剑、偃月或任意近战攻击伤害目标会使其疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

description.en: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
description.zh-CN: 使用刀剑或偃月格挡攻击后，下次解除格挡时，会在短时间内获得针对目标的伤害抗性。

description.en: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药会从备弹中填装收起的特殊武器。

description.en: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
description.zh-CN: 使用超能造成伤害后，你移动时会逐渐回复生命值和护盾。额外超能伤害可刷新此效果。

description.en: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
description.zh-CN: 使用虚空能量快速击败战斗人员会生成虚空裂口。

description.en: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
description.zh-CN: 收集虚空裂口后，你下一次使用虚空武器造成的最后一击会触发爆炸。收集虚空裂口后迅速触发的爆炸更强力。

description.en: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
description.zh-CN: 对战斗人员执行终结技，或造成连续充能近战最后一击，会根据你的光能分支职业生成一个元素拾取物。

description.en: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员执行终结技会获得治疗并生成忠于你的虚空飞蛾。

description.en: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.
description.zh-CN: 瞄准时造成精准最后一击会提供伤害抗性，直至你停止瞄准。

description.en:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
description.zh-CN:
使用任意武器造成精准最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，在短时间内提升填装速度、目标捕获能力以及对非首领战斗人员造成的武器伤害。

造成非精准直接命中的武器最后一击将提前结束此效果。

zh-CN.name: 奈扎雷克的梦魇
zh-CN.realgame_details: 低压环境的产球选择，任意击杀 3 个元素{debuff|减益}影响的{enemy|战斗人员}就能产出{orb|能量球}，适合不稳定弹药/拆解子弹武器，逃逸手/忍野等等一切有频繁元素{debuff|减益}的玩法，{art-perk|压制偃月}虫手泰坦也是优秀的使用案例\\适合与空降灭火套装配合使用

description.en: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 对受到分支职业减益影响的目标造成最后一击有递增的几率生成能量球。

description.en: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员施展终结技可提供吞食。拥有吞食时，获得对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

description.en: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
description.zh-CN: 主弹药武器最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，提升敏捷、主武器射程和操控性，直至你被击败。

description.en: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
description.zh-CN: 提升敏捷并强化冲刺速度和滑行距离。

zh-CN.name: 克洛塔记忆
zh-CN.realgame_details: 类似{perk|混沌重塑}机制的减伤效果，脱战 7 秒后才失去效果比较理想

description.en: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
description.zh-CN: 近战最后一击会触发一次诅咒怨魂爆炸。

description.en: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
description.zh-CN: 处于战斗中一段时间会逐渐获得更多对战斗人员的抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 应许之物
zh-CN.realgame_details: 只需要击杀{bar-orange|橙血}就可以获得抵抗 X2 和额外武器增伤 12 秒，持续时间长并且很容易获取。无法与其他抵抗来源叠加

description.en: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
description.zh-CN: 击败强力战斗人员会生成稳定共振，在持续时间内提供伤害抗性和提升武器伤害。

description.en: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
description.zh-CN: 拥有稳定共振时，持续造成武器伤害偶尔会产生共振爆发，伤害目标并使其疲惫。

zh-CN.name: 空降灭火套装
zh-CN.realgame_details: 持续{orb|能量球}产出的不错减伤来源，适合与梦根 2 或者小锤泰坦等高频产球配装搭配使用

description.en: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
description.zh-CN: 拾取能量球时，你会获得短暂且快速衰减的伤害减免效果。

description.en: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
description.zh-CN: 使用终结技击败强力战斗人员可获得特殊弹药进度，并恢复少量生命值。

description.en: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
description.zh-CN: 切换到热量武器、微型冲锋枪或手炮会在短时间内提升操控性和精度。使用该武器造成伤害可延长此效果。

description.en: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
description.zh-CN: 在反射动作生效时造成最后一击会获得武器属性提升，并在一定时间内提升热量武器、微型冲锋枪和手炮的稳定性、填装和瞄准辅助。

description.en: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
description.zh-CN: 造成最后一击后填装自动步枪、斥候步枪或手枪可缓慢恢复生命值，直至你重新进入战斗。

description.en: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
description.zh-CN: 当你陷入生命危急或治疗生命危急的盟友时，自动步枪、斥候步枪和手枪会暂时获得射程、稳定性和填装速度提升。

zh-CN.name: 溢冰
zh-CN.realgame_details: bug 的每 12 秒一次弹药进度和{orb|能量球}

description.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 脱离战斗一定时间后，你的下一次最后一击提供额外弹药进度并生成一个能量球。

description.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
description.zh-CN: 脱离战斗一定时间后，缓慢获得冰霜护甲直到你再次进入战斗。

zh-CN.name: 移民号陨落
zh-CN.realgame_details: 简单获取的常驻减伤效果，需要有{orb|能量球}产出，因为 4 层充能后收益不佳，不需要携带多个完全充能，通常只需要 1 个层层不绝+绿弹终结/快速启动模组即可

description.en: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
description.zh-CN: 你的护盾被击破时，自动收集附近所有的能量球与弹药盒。

description.en:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
description.zh-CN:
获得、失去或消耗护甲充能时，在短时间内获得治疗和伤害减免。

此效果根据获得、失去和消耗的护甲充能数量而调整。

description.en: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
description.zh-CN: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升主弹药武器的填装速度。

description.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
description.zh-CN: 拾取能量球会提供特殊弹药进度。

zh-CN.name: 双重王冠
zh-CN.realgame_details: 搭配{art-perk|动能合成}作为有效回血手段，常与光剑圣贤搭配

description.en: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药盒会治疗你。

description.en: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
description.zh-CN: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升你雷达的分辨率。

zh-CN.name: 积雨云
zh-CN.realgame_details: 只对近距离 5m 范围内的{enemy|战斗人员}有减伤，数值够高，适合一些频繁使用手雷的配装（忍野、幼龙手）。原本是最适配勾爪肘击的套装，但是现在强度不足基本没上场空间

description.en: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
description.zh-CN: 激活手雷或纳米技术追踪导弹原始特性会为近距离来袭伤害提供可叠加的抗性。

description.en: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
description.zh-CN: 击败被瓦解的战斗人员会提供手雷技能能量。如果你的手雷能量已充满，则获得特殊弹药量表进度。

description.en: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
description.zh-CN: 主弹药武器对迷失方向的战斗人员造成更高伤害。

description.en: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
description.zh-CN: 你的手雷技能在爆炸不久后额外释放一次扰乱脉冲。

description.en: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
description.zh-CN: 受到来自战斗人员的伤害时可能生成一只线虫。

description.en: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
description.zh-CN: 你的护盾被击破后的短时间内，你接下来的几次线虫命中会回复生命值。

zh-CN.name: 铁能
zh-CN.realgame_details: 触发条件简单，抵抗 1 几乎常驻。不能与其他抵抗来源叠加

description.en: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
description.zh-CN: 当你的护盾开始回复时，你在短时间内获得抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

description.en: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
description.zh-CN: 当你的弹药储备较低时，使用武器对战斗人员造成最后一击，会根据武器弹药类型提供额外的弹药进度。主弹药武器可提升特殊弹药进度，特殊弹药武器可提升重型弹药进度。

description.en: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
description.zh-CN: 接受治疗时暂时为你的烈日武器提升抖动抗性、操控性和填装速度。

description.en: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
description.zh-CN: 快速烈日最后一击会治疗你。

zh-CN.name: 圣贤保护者
zh-CN.realgame_details: 单独用效果一般，但是剑刃风暴连击可以触发大大提升了技能回转能力\\常与光剑王冠套配合使用

description.en: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
description.zh-CN: 刀剑命中返还手雷和职业能量。如果启用利刃专注，还将获得额外能量。

description.en: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
description.zh-CN: 使用刀剑短暂格档来让利刃专注就绪。利刃专注就绪时，用刀剑命中目标会在一定时间内提升刀剑伤害和前冲距离。
